composition_summary: Preserved the supplied user message unchanged in adjusted_volatile_messages; no justified prompt repair was warranted. Drafted one class-22 pure-logic component, pc-check-channel-list, as an unapproved target-interface draft. The body reads channels with inputs.get so an absent key is a valid empty-list outcome rather than a KeyError, validates that channels is a list, that each element is an exact integer (not a bool) in 0..255 inclusive, and assigns result={ok,channels} on every path without exceptions, imports, host calls or coercion. The outer input contract admits the raw candidate shape (missing/null/wrong-typed) while the inner validation implements the rule; it returns an invalid-result object rather than raising. No UUID, version, association or approval was supplied, and the host sink supports only class 22 name/description/content, so no other proposal arrays were populated. Typed inputs remain a target interface, not deployed runtime support.

payload.name: pc-check-channel-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validator: accepts a raw channels value that is a list whose items are exact integers 0..255 inclusive (including an empty list); returns {ok, channels} with the original list when valid or an empty list otherwise. No exceptions, imports, host calls or coercion. Target interface; actual input/result contracts and runner support remain unresolved.
